create_NgramEmbedding: create an NgramEmbedding module with vocabulary size, embedding dimension, and over-embedding parameters
init_buffers_NgramEmbedding: init buffer tensors for n-gram IDs and request length sums given max running requests and chunked prefill size
load_weight_NgramEmbedding: load pretrained embedding weights for word embedder, over-embedders, and projection layers by weight name
run_forward_NgramEmbedding: run the forward pass to compute averaged n-gram embeddings from input token IDs and forward batch info
summarize_NgramEmbedding: summarize the NgramEmbedding class that combines word-level and n-gram embeddings with over-embedding projection
